Bettina, the official handoff date is **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 November says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03", and your own cutover recap from 8 December 2025 gives the same official date.

For the tracker, you may also want the note in that recap: you kept running Pellucid day to day until 21 November, and Kwame fully took over on 22 November. If the tracker has a separate "day-to-day" field, that's the date for it.
